agentixaction.description:
Sends an email using one of the configured mail integrations.
The `body` content must be valid, well-formed HTML or Markdown.
HTML is recommended for consistent rendering across email clients.
Works with any integration that exposes the `send-mail` command. Known integrations include:
- Mail Sender (New) – Generic SMTP integration (e.g., Exchange, Postfix, SendGrid)
- EWS Mail Sender / EWS On-Premise – Microsoft Exchange Web Services
- Gmail / Gmail Single User – Google Gmail API with OAuth 2.0
- Microsoft Graph Mail / Graph Mail Single User – Microsoft 365 Graph API
agentixaction.name: SendEmail

agentixaction.description:
A comprehensive action to enrich the provided file indicator and retrieve all available data.
The results include both tenant-specific internal information and global threat intelligence.
Global threat intelligence is retrieved using configured integrations to identify potential threats.
ACTION REDUNDANCY WARNING: Due to its comprehensive nature, DO NOT use 'EnrichIndicator' or 'CortexListIndicators' in parallel with this action, as the data is already included in the output.
PREREQUISITE: Ensure that one or more of these external integrations are configured in your environment.
agentixaction.name: EnrichFile

agentixaction.description: Updates issue properties. It can be used to perform actions like marking an issue as resolved, escalating/de-escalating its severity, or changing the assigned user. This action does not provide an explicit indication of success. Fetch issue details after executing this command to verify that the desired changes were applied successfully.
agentixaction.name: CortexUpdateIssue

agentixaction.description:
A comprehensive action to enrich the provided domain indicator and retrieve all available data.
The results include both tenant-specific internal information (from the Threat Intelligence Management (TIM) brand) and global threat intelligence.
Global threat intelligence is retrieved using configured integrations to identify potential threats.
USE ONLY for bare domain names — inputs must be plain hostnames without a protocol or "www." prefix.
DO NOT USE this action for values that include a protocol (such as http:// or https://) or start with www., as these are classified as URLs rather than domains.
ACTION REDUNDANCY WARNING: Due to its comprehensive nature, DO NOT use 'EnrichIndicator' or 'CortexListIndicators' in parallel with this action, as the data is already included in the output.
PREREQUISITE: Ensure that one or more of these external integrations are configured in your environment.
agentixaction.name: EnrichDomain

agentixaction.description: Searches the threat intelligence database for relationships between indicators based on specified criteria. Returns relationships where at least one side of the relationship matches a value in entities or matches a type in related_entity_types. The search can be narrowed to return only specific relationship types between the entities. All filters use AND logic between different filter types, while multiple values within a single filter use OR logic.
agentixaction.name: CortexListIndicatorRelationships

agentixaction.description: Enriches existing Cortex indicators with reputation and intelligence data using the specified indicator values.
agentixaction.name: EnrichIndicator

agentixaction.description:
Retrieves all available threat intelligence and reputation data for an email address using configured integrations.
This includes associations with phishing campaigns, malicious activity, and breach data.
Ensure that one or more of these integrations are configured in your environment to retrieve enrichment using the email command.
PREREQUISITE: Ensure that one or more of these external integrations are configured in your environment.
agentixaction.name: EnrichEmail

agentixaction.name: EnrichIP

PREREQUISITE: Ensure that one or more of these external integrations are configured in your environment.
agentixaction.name: EnrichCVE

agentixaction.description:
A comprehensive action to enrich the provided URL indicator and retrieve all available data.
The results include both tenant-specific internal information and global threat intelligence.
Global threat intelligence is retrieved using configured integrations to identify potential malicious activity.
USE ONLY for URLs — inputs must have a protocol (http://, https://) or start with "www.".
DO NOT USE this action for bare hostnames (e.g., example.com or openclaw.ai).
ACTION REDUNDANCY WARNING: Due to its comprehensive nature, DO NOT use 'EnrichIndicator' or 'CortexListIndicators' in parallel with this action, as the data is already included in the output.
PREREQUISITE: Ensure that one or more of these external integrations are configured in your environment.
